preConditions.sqlCheck: WITH facts AS ( SELECT attempt.id, attempt.status, attempt.summary_json, jsonb_array_length(attempt.selected_closure_json) AS selected, count(result.id) AS terminal, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.status = 'CREATED') AS created, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.status = 'UPDATED') AS updated, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.status = 'SKIPPED') AS skipped, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.status = 'REPLAYED') AS replayed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.status = 'FAILED') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.status = 'BLOCKED') AS blocked FROM modeling_model_spec_import_apply_attempt attempt LEFT JOIN modeling_model_spec_import_apply_result result ON result.attempt_id = attempt.id GROUP BY attempt.id ) SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE terminal > selected OR (status <> 'RUNNING' AND terminal <> selected) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND terminal = selected) OR ( status <> 'RUNNING' AND ( COALESCE((summary_json ->> 'total')::int, -1) <> terminal OR COALESCE((summary_json ->> 'created')::int, -1) <> created OR COALESCE((summary_json ->> 'updated')::int, -1) <> updated OR COALESCE((summary_json ->> 'skipped')::int, -1) <> skipped OR COALESCE((summary_json ->> 'replayed')::int, -1) <> replayed OR COALESCE((summary_json ->> 'failed')::int, -1) <> failed OR COALESCE((summary_json ->> 'blocked')::int, -1) <> blocked ) )

SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec_import_apply_attempt attempt WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT expected.dbt_unique_id FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(attempt.selected_closure_json) AS expected(dbt_unique_id) EXCEPT SELECT result.dbt_unique_id FROM modeling_model_spec_import_apply_result result WHERE result.attempt_id = attempt.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT result.dbt_unique_id FROM modeling_model_spec_import_apply_result result WHERE result.attempt_id = attempt.id EXCEPT SELECT expected.dbt_unique_id FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(attempt.selected_closure_json) AS expected(dbt_unique_id) )
